[[Banor's Sacred Branch]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Banor Greenbranch]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Holdings of Chokhin]].

==Stats==
: [[Energy]] +10
: [[Holy damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Protection Prayers]])
: Halves skill recharge of spells (Chance: 20%)
: [[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
: [[Health]] +60
